description: REQ-M1 (in spec required:true list per manifest) defines a build_log section schema with header '## YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ — pass <pass_id>' followed by fields. The implementation's format_log_section emits '## pass {pass_id} (ts {ts})' — different shape, plain epoch instead of ISO 8601 timestamp, no em-dash separator, no Z-suffixed UTC. parse_log_section round-trip works but does not consume the spec'd schema. A consumer following REQ-M1 to parse a real build_log would not interoperate. Tests only check round-trip with this implementation's own format, not the spec'd schema.
